g.text: Outline: the operational wiki, fed by every infra layer
Three hostnames, one instance. Postgres, Redis, Garage S3 and Authentik OIDC sit behind it.
URL pinned to wiki.xiiisins.com so links and
Why Redis on emptyDir: an iSCSI claim hit the
NAS LUN cap, and nothing in Redis is canonical.
Why one Redis per app: separate blast radius
and no eviction fights with Authentik.
Sources: docs/services/outline.md, docs/services/garage.md. Outline is the operational notebook; docs/ in Git is the deploy-shape record.
